field_contract.decision_reviewer: Named human reviewer; not Codex or an automated process.
field_contract.final_physical_gate_status: Must be ready_for_stage17_final_physical_completion_decision before any Stage 17 completion claim is considered.
field_contract.final_physical_gate_record_path: Path to the saved final physical gate output or record; not a transcript.
field_contract.decision_locks: Use unquoted JSON boolean true only after real records are reviewed and all no-clearance locks are preserved.
field_contract.stage17_completion_claim_requested: Use unquoted JSON boolean true only if a human reviewer is requesting ledger-backed Stage 17 completion consideration.
field_contract.physical_validation_accepted_by_human_re: Use unquoted JSON boolean true only after real physical records are reviewed outside the read-only gate.
field_contract.completion_ledger_update_required: Use unquoted JSON boolean true only if the decision is intended for the completion ledger.
field_contract.completion_decision_notes: Must name remaining limitations and must not claim powered, frame-coupled, load-bearing, or FR-018 clearance.
